      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Using a startup option for a one-time migration creates redundancy and potential configuration conflicts with existing options like -blocksxor",
      "quote": "I don't like using startup options for one-time operations ... maybe we can bundle this e.g. as part of `bitcoin-util` or a separate `bitcoin-xor-blocks` utility?",

    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2338593448",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Progress reporting resets when finishing undo files before block files, creating an uneven progress display",

      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author grouped block and undo files for uniform progress iteration",

      ],
      "other_replies": [],

      "status_by_id": "rc:2365380262",
      "status_by_quote": "grouped the block and undo files for more uniform iteration instead of shuffling"
    },

      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Reset the timestamp of rewritten block files to match original timestamps",
      "quote": "Would be good to try to reset the timestamp of new_blocks to match that of old_blocks here.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author initially implemented timestamp preservation, but later removed it in c:5901894922 explaining it breaks incremental backups",

      "status_note": "author adopted chunking from reviewer branch",

      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Reobfuscation fails or misbehaves on pruned nodes where blk0000.dat has been deleted",
      "quote": "This doesn't seem like it would work correctly with pruning, when blk0000.dat has been deleted?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author changed file detection back to regex matching",

        "rc:2342882442"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:2342882442",
      "status_by_quote": "Good call, changed it back to regex matching"
    },

      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Adding one-time migration logic to bitcoind adds unnecessary code to the daemon when a standalone utility requires very little of the existing codebase",
      "quote": "I agree a separate utility for this seems better - this requires very little of the existing codebase, in theory.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author noted that an external tool already exists",

      "status_by_id": "c:3305103297",
      "status_by_quote": "Besides, @andrewtoth already has a tool for that, it was mentioned in the PR description."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:3305066838",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Write reobfuscated files to a new directory with original names and atomically rename the directory when complete, rather than renaming every individual file",

      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author raised issues with directory copying and lack of visible progress; reviewer did not follow up",

        "c:3305103297"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:3305103297",
      "status_by_quote": "I will think about it, could make sense, but in that case unrelated files should also be copied over (maybe duplicated to be safe) - and listing the directory content wouldn't make the progress obvious. What's wrong with the current approach?"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3397152913",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Downgrade or remove the startup warning for unobfuscated block files",
      "quote": "Not sure if a warning is really warranted here. Feel like this pull request would have gotten more review over the past year if this were a pressing operation.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author downgraded startup notice from warning to info",

      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:4525334593",
      "status_by_quote": "Downgraded the unobfuscated-blocks startup notice from warning to info."
    },

      "kind": "maintenance",

      "quote": "How about moving it to right before the cache size calculations in `AppInitMain`. It could also be moved into its little function.",

      "status_by_quote": "Moved the startup reobfuscation handling out of `InitAndLoadChainstate` into `ReobfuscateBlocksIfRequested()`, called before cache sizing in `AppInitMain`."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3399270951",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Malformed hex key lengths for -reobfuscate-blocks are not treated as fatal errors on startup",
      "quote": "It feels a bit off that getting the length wrong is not fatal.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author made key parsing fail early on invalid hex lengths",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3436230263",
        "r:4525334593"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:4525334593",
      "status_by_quote": "Made `-reobfuscate-blocks` parsing stricter: only `0`, empty/`1`, or exact 16-character hex keys are accepted; wrong-length keys now fail early"
    },

      "id": "rc:3399281100",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Where does preserving block file timestamps become relevant?",
      "quote": "I don't quite understand what the purpose of this is. Where does the timestamp become relevant?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained it was requested by ajtowns to minimize unintended changes",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3436172644"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3436172644",
      "status_by_quote": "Was explicitly requested to minimize unintended changes"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3399344277",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Mark the kernel notification for reobfuscation progress as resumable",
      "quote": "Could this be the first kernel notification where resume is possible?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author marked GUI reobfuscation progress as resumable",

      "status_by_id": "r:4525334593",
      "status_by_quote": "Marked GUI reobfuscation progress as resumable and reused a single translated progress title."
